method: Every catalogue hold effect is a reviewed family. reviewed_refs must equal the set of pinned src/**/*.c references to that HOLD_EFFECT_* symbol (AI, debug and animation sources excluded), so a new or moved read fails source-check instead of silently inheriting a decision. identity_reference_sites must equal the set of enclosing definitions of literal ITEM_* catalogue symbols in pinned src/battle_*.c. Categories are reviewed input; the generator never infers one.

HOLD_EFFECT_MEMORY.rationale: No hold-effect reference in pinned battle code. HOLD_EFFECT_PRIMAL_ORB.rationale: Primal Reversion items: no hold-effect read in battle code; the reversion itself is driven by form-change tables and its timing was not audited for this slice. Fails closed.

ITEM_ENIGMA_BERRY_E_READER.rationale: The e-Reader Enigma Berry has no static holdEffect: GetBattlerHoldEffectInternal returns the runtime gEnigmaBerries[battler].holdEffect for this exact ID (src/battle_util.c:5834). Its catalogue HOLD_EFFECT_NONE is therefore not its battle effect; it is not classified by family and fails closed.
